ordering_evidence.method: file modification time, observed live during the pass-1 authoring session
ordering_evidence.observed: rubric.md existed and was unmodified before the first render was written; tools/verify.mjs asserted mtime(rubric.md) <= mtime(earliest render) and passed on 2026-08-03
ordering_evidence.limitation: modification time does not survive a fresh Git checkout, so it cannot be re-observed later. This lock replaces it: the rubric bytes are now pinned by digest, and every future render must be produced against exactly these bytes.
ordering_evidence.honest_scope: This records that the ordering was observed once, by the author, in the session that created both files. It is not independent corroboration.

rule: tools/verify.mjs recomputes the digest of rubric.md on every run and fails if it differs. Changing a gate means adding a new dated rubric and a new lock, never editing these bytes in place.
